properties.title: IAU Planetary Nomenclature: Moon (centre points)
properties.producer_full_name: International Astronomical Union (IAU) & U.S. Geological Survey, Astrogeology Science Center
properties.lri:download_note: Downloaded from USGS Astrogeology Planetary Nomenclature as Shapefile. Re-download to check for new approved names; source is updated weekly.
properties.lri:data_use_note: Feature name labels overlaid on the Cesium 3D viewer. Labels filtered by camera altitude to avoid clutter. Key attributes for display: name (with diacritics), clean_name (without diacritics), type (feature descriptor, e.g. Crater/Mare/Mons), diameter (km), center_lon, center_lat.

attributes.name: Name as approved by the IAU, including diacritical marks
attributes.clean_name: Name without diacritical marks (for display systems that cannot render them)
attributes.type: IAU descriptor term (e.g. Crater, Mare, Mons, Vallis, Rima, Rupes, Dorsum, Lacus, Sinus, Planitia, Planum, Terra, Patera, Promontorium, Catena, Fossa, Regio, Oceanus, Palus, Satellite Feature, Landing site name)
attributes.diameter: Approximate diameter or longest dimension in kilometres
attributes.center_lon: Longitude of feature centre (degrees, PositiveEast, 0 to 360)
attributes.center_lat: Planetocentric latitude of feature centre (positive = north)
attributes.approvaldt: IAU approval date: full date (YYYY-MM-DD) from mid-September 2006 onwards; year only before that
attributes.approval: IAU approval status as full text (e.g. 'Adopted by IAU', 'Dropped', 'Never approved')
attributes.origin: Short explanation of the name's origin
attributes.code: Country or ethnic group code for name origin
attributes.ethnicity: Country or ethnic group of name origin
attributes.continent: Continent or large geographic division of name origin
attributes.quad_name: Planetary quadrant name containing the feature centre
attributes.quad_code: Planetary quadrant code containing the feature centre
attributes.link: Direct URL to the feature's entry in the Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature

geojson.title: GeoJSON: all 9085 features (all Adopted by IAU), lon normalised -180 to 180, CRS IAU:30100

processing_script.title: Conversion script (Shapefile to GeoJSON via GDAL)
